title: Restore reliable Chinese and English transcription
summary: Replace the broken ONNX q8 path with a verified runtime and add explicit fallbacks, diagnostics, and real-audio smoke tests.
acceptanceCriteria: A real Mandarin fixture produces timestamped non-empty transcript segments.
A real English fixture produces timestamped English transcript segments.
English-to-Chinese translation produces non-empty Chinese text or a truthful recoverable error.
The known Missing required scale error is covered by a runtime compatibility test or eliminated by the selected architecture.
Model download, cache failure, offline state, and retry have user-readable states.
npm run check and npm run build pass.
